visualCharacteristics.purpose: intro text column beside a vertical list of icon items (icon followed by short text)

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: cell 1 = intro heading/text, cell 2 = icon items, either a bullet list whose items start with an icon, or paragraphs each starting with an icon followed by text

usage: Feature/benefit lists with icons on corporate and service pages.
reuseGuidance: Use when a short icon list sits beside intro copy. For icon grids in cards use cards.
